📖 Premiere Pro & After Effects Import Guide

🎬 Method 1 — Premiere Pro XML (Easiest)

Caption Studio mein captions tayyar karo → Export → Premiere Pro XML click karo
Premiere Pro kholain → File → Import (Ctrl+I)
Downloaded .xml file select karo → Open
Project panel mein file aayegi → Sequence mein drag karo
Captions apne aap timeline pe exact timing ke saath place ho jayenge ✅
💡 Pro tip: XML mein har caption ka exact in/out point hota hai — manually kuch adjust nahi karna padega.

✨ Method 2 — After Effects Animated Script

Caption Studio → Export → After Effects Script (.jsx) download karo
After Effects kholain → Apna project/composition open karo
File → Scripts → Run Script File → downloaded .jsx file chunain
Script automatically har word ke liye animated text layer banayega timeline pe
Har word ke liye Scale Bounce animation already applied hoga — render karo! ✅
💡 Scale Bounce animation: Har word 0 → 120% → 100% scale karta hai exact us waqt jab bola jaata hai. Bilkul CapCut style!

📄 Method 3 — SRT (Universal)

Caption Studio → Export → .SRT
Premiere Pro → File → Import → .srt file
Timeline pe Captions track mein drag karo
Basic captions — agar animated chahiye to AE method use karo
🎓 Recommended Workflow:
Caption Studio (transcribe + sync) → Export AE Script → After Effects (style + render) → Premiere Pro (final edit)
